mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sql_trace ( session_id, user_id, trace_id, datasource_id, datasource_name, database_name, table_names, sql_text, result_json, row_count, truncated, duration_ms, create_time ) VALUES ( #{sessionId}, #{userId}, #{traceId}, #{datasourceId}, #{datasourceName}, #{databaseName}, #{tableNames}, #{sqlText}, #{resultJson}, #{rowCount}, #{truncated}, #{durationMs}, #{createTime} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, session_id, user_id, trace_id, datasource_id, datasource_name, database_name, table_names, sql_text, row_count, truncated, duration_ms, create_time FROM sql_trace WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY id DESC
